s.t: Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. We’ve built a product that users love, and we plan to keep it that way by continuing to empathize with users and help them overcome their most significant challenges. Designing at Elation is humbling, challenging, and rewarding. Our users do work that affects human lives, and our tools can make or break that work.

As a Design Technologist , you'll own the design and engineering of Elation’s design system while defining how AI-native systems compose UI — directing the interaction patterns, visual language, and developer experience that make it all feel simple.
Primary care clinicians have repeatedly awarded Elation "Best in KLAS" in our category, a recognition that reflects our clinician-first approach to design. Reporting up through our Chief Product Officer, you'll work within our frontend platform team to collaborate with everyone from the designers and engineers within Elation to the physicians who rely on our product every day, delivering care to more than 25 million patients.
The right candidate thrives in complexity and brings the craft and curiosity this role requires. If you want to do complex, meaningful work at the place where design, engineering, and healthcare intersect, we'd love to hear from you!

Own the architecture, strategy, design, engineering, and evolution of Elation’s design system.
Lead an AI-agent-first rearchitecting of the design system. Encoding composition rules and component guidelines for an agent to discover and apply.
Help define Elation’s AI-native experience through component design, pattern development, and an opinionated point of view that moves how design and engineering build.
Help shape our application’s design direction and visual language.
Deeply understand and research our users — their problems, workflows, and jobs-to-be-done — to build the best-in-class tools for their work.
Support your partners in design and engineering to leverage these systems.

Success in this role can take many different shapes — we don’t expect you to arrive having mastered every part of it. If you feel you’re a strong candidate for this role and excited to collaborate, we encourage you to apply.
5+ years of experience creating and shipping complex, web-based products in a cross-functional team as a designer, engineer, or related role.
2+ years leading cross-functional projects or initiatives, with a proven record of driving strategy and execution.
A genuine multi-discipline practitioner. Strong at both design craft and building with modern frontend frameworks.
Strong knowledge of design systems.
Experience in health tech or other compliance-heavy industries.
AI-native work practices and experience building with agentic tools like Claude Code or Cursor.

Experience designing or building for AI-native user experiences.
Strong API literacy and data modeling experience.
Accessibility and WCAG experience.
Experience building AI platform or infrastructure (MCP servers, eval harnesses, token build pipelines).
Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.
We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.
Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

Required
Experience in UX Design, Product Design, Creative Design, Design Technology, or a related field.
Expert in Figma for UX design, wireframing, prototyping, design systems, and cross- functional collaboration.
Strong understanding of UX design processes, design thinking, and creative workflows.
Experience using AI-powered tools for design, prototyping, content creation, and workflow optimization.
Proficiency with modern design and prototyping platforms such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and similar tools.
Advance proficiency in Figma for UX design, wireframing, and prototyping.
Strong visual design, communication, and presentation skills.
Ideal Candidate
Understands both the UX process and creative design process.
Is highly proficient in using AI to create high-fidelity prototypes and experience concepts.
Has hands-on experience using AI to generate images, videos, creative assets, and storytelling content.
Can leverage AI to conduct website assessments, usability reviews, and experience evaluations.
Enjoys experimenting with new tools and finding innovative ways to improve workflows.
Thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments and can quickly bring ideas from concept to reality.
AI-Powered Design & Prototyping
Create high-fidelity prototypes using AI-powered design and development tools.
Rapidly transform concepts into interactive experiences for stakeholder reviews, customer validation, and usability testing.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate wireframing, design exploration, user flows, and experience simulations.
Support teams in moving from idea to testable prototype with greater speed and efficiency.
Creative Asset Generation
Use AI tools to create and refine visual assets, including images, illustrations, videos, presentations, and other creative content.
Partner with creative, content, marketing, and UX teams to develop assets that align with brand standards and project goals.
Experiment with emerging AI capabilities to enhance storytelling, concept communication, and design execution.
Maintain awareness of evolving AI tools and best practices within the creative industry.
UX & Experience Assessment
Conduct website and digital experience assessments using AI-assisted tools and methodologies.
Analyze usability, accessibility, content effectiveness, visual consistency, and customer experience opportunities.
Generate insights, recommendations, and improvement strategies that help elevate digital experiences.
Support heuristic evaluations, competitive analyses, and customer experience reviews.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with UX, Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Marketing teams to support innovation initiatives.
Help establish AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency across design and creative processes.
Share best practices, emerging trends, and AI capabilities with team members.
Contribute to a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and innovation.

As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration , you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.
In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft.

You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration.

Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.
Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.
Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.
Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.
Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.
Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.
Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, structures, and systems engineering teams to optimize thermal integration within the aircraft.
Support simulation activities and correlate analytical models with physical test results where appropriate.
Prepare technical documentation, verification reports, and engineering recommendations.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience developing and integrating thermal management or cooling systems in aerospace, automotive, motorsport, industrial machinery, or similar industries.
Hands-on experience designing and integrating air-cooled systems, aerodynamic cooling solutions, or airflow management for engines, electronics, or other high-power systems.
Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, cooling system design, airflow management, and thermal testing .
Experience with cooling components such as heat exchangers, fans, ducting, air intakes, ventilation systems, and thermal insulation.
Experience designing and executing engineering validation and prototype test campaigns.
Familiarity with CAD tools ( CATIA preferred); experience with CFD or thermal simulation tools is advantageous but not essential.
Experience with thermal instrumentation, sensors, and data acquisition systems.
Programming experience with Python , MATLAB , or similar data analysis tools is an advantage.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.
We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.
We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.
We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Hybrid Power & Fuel System Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.
In this role, you will take ownership of the integration, development, and validation of the aircraft's hybrid power generation system, including the internal combustion engine, fuel storage and delivery system, generator, and associated electrical and control interfaces.

You will ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of the complete propulsion system throughout the prototype development cycle by working closely with mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, and systems engineering teams.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Lead the integration of the hybrid propulsion system, including the combustion engine, fuel system, generator, and power electronics into prototype aircraft.
Develop and validate fuel storage, distribution, and delivery systems, including tanks, pumps, filters, valves, sensors, and plumbing.
Design, build, and commission test rigs and dedicated test stands.
Develop and execute functional, endurance, and performance test campaigns for fuel and hybrid power systems.
Set up, integrate, commission, and troubleshoot combustion engines, generators, fuel systems, and associated control systems.
Analyze system performance, efficiency, reliability, and failure modes, implementing design improvements based on test results.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, electrical, controls, and systems engineering teams to optimize system integration and aircraft performance.
Prepare technical documentation, verification reports, test procedures, and engineering recommendations to support prototype development.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience integrating and testing combustion engines, hybrid propulsion systems, gensets, fuel systems, or power generation systems.
Hands-on experience setting up, integrating, commissioning, and testing internal combustion engines and associated fuel systems.
Strong understanding of fuel systems, fluid dynamics, pressure systems, combustion engines, generators, electrical power systems, and hybrid propulsion architectures.
Experience designing, building, and operating engineering test setups, test stands, and validation rigs.
Experience with instrumentation, sensors, CAN communication, embedded systems, avionics integration, and data acquisition.
Programming experience using Python, MATLAB, C++, LabVIEW, or similar for test automation and data analysis is an advantage.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a hands-on approach to prototype development.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Amazon is seeking a Senior Prototyping Engineer to join the AWS Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering team. As part of an agile AI enabled development team you will support AWS customers to develop prototypes specific to their articulated strategic vision for new products and services.
Our Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering (PACE) capability is designed to help our customers leverage this new way of working to deliver tangible technology and business outcomes using lean principles, iterative AI/GenAI powered agile development, agentic approaches through multi-functional teams and a lightweight rapid development cycle.
The prototyping team is a hands-on team of cross functional developers supporting AWS customers to build rapid MVP experiments adapted to their specific, innovation focused, use cases. The role of a Prototyping Engineer is to apply these methods to assemble and deliver technology and business outcomes for the world’s leading clients.The job will cover the LATAM geography, with some traveling to customer sites.

· Architect, develop, test and implement loosely coupled distributed software solutions.
· Research and employ up-to-date technological developments in customer engagements.
· Drive the AWS platform by aligning customer requirements with AWS service teams’ roadmaps.
· This role will focus on customers using AWS for research, development, and innovation.
· Author or contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as white-papers, tutorials, blogs, etc.
· Position requires travel, generally, between 0 - 25%.
